title: scroll-craft: Claude Code skill for scroll-driven landing QA
summary: MIT Claude Code plugin that builds premium scroll-timeline marketing pages with eight page grammars, craft refuse-lists, and a Playwright screenshot walk that checks dead scroll, contrast, and stuck video legs.
question_it_answers: How do I ship a scroll-driven landing with agent-enforced design floors and automated QA?

claims.text: The skill enforces eight mutually exclusive page grammars plus a required signature move with a fingerprint gate.
claims.evidence: Eight mutually exclusive page grammars (filmic one-shot, chaptered editorial, live surface, etc.)
claims.subject: landing-ui-motion

claims.text: Verification uses a Playwright scroll walk for dead scroll, per-line contrast, and stuck video legs.
claims.evidence: Verification: Playwright scroll walk — dead scroll, contrast per line, stuck video legs
claims.subject: landing-ui-motion

claims.text: A default-Claude slop fixture fires the taste.md refuse list (3-col cards, gradient text, invented stats, AI-purple, em dash, scroll cue, 01/06, dual CTAs) and matches none of the eight uniqueness.md grammars. Checklist on a fixture, not a headed skill run.
claims.evidence: analysis/_work/captures/default-claude-landing.html scored against plugins/.../taste.md refuse list and uniqueness.md §2.1–2.8 forbids. See scroll-craft NOTES.
claims.subject: landing-ui-motion

claims.text: Headed Chrome 390x844 on the default-Claude fixture measured Inter, h1 83.2px, and hero min-height 1012.8px against an 844px viewport (overflow). Three viewport PNGs are under analysis/_work/captures/claude-landing-mobile/.
claims.evidence: playwright-core + google-chrome; scrollHeight 2560; top/mid/end PNGs 243841 / 43608 / 31519 B.
claims.subject: landing-ui-motion

claims.text: Live shoot.mjs on nateherk.com walked 13.1 viewport-heights across pin>flow>pin>flow>pan>flow>pin (22 frames). failed and consoleErrors were empty; named cues stayed at or above 4.5:1 (worst close-line 5.55).
claims.evidence: analysis/_work/captures/nateherk-shoot/report.json: height 11754 / vh 900; 22 frames; contrast worst 17.87 / 17.84 / 17.99 / 5.55; clips [].
claims.subject: landing-ui-motion
